task_config.context_text: Counterfactual policy scenario: Ireland introduced a free RSV immunisation program (Nirsevimab) on 2024-09-01 to protect infants, focusing on newborns and high-risk babies during winter. The program is provided in maternity hospitals, with catch-up options for infants already born before the start date. Nirsevimab acts immediately and lasts for roughly 5 months, so from 2024-09-01 onward the forecast should reflect reduced RSV-related respiratory disease burden among children under one year old compared with no program.
